races.name: Welcome To The Perth Festival Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Off The Jury
runners_data.note: Top-rated hold-up horse but needs genuine pace to unleash his finish, which may be absent here with only one front-runner

runners_data.name: Holy Joe
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced Elliott inmate with unknown hurdles ability but the yard's 14-day record suggests confidence

runners_data.name: Expensive Emotion
runners_data.note: Previous winner stepping up from bumpers with unknown going preferences creating risk

runners_data.name: Gee Force Flyer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed to track Newbrook Diamond and benefits from the lack of early pace pressure

runners_data.name: Newbrook Diamond
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter with solid recent form but 17-day break could affect fitness levels slightly

runners_data.name: Heffalump
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after wind surgery from in-form McCain yard, suggesting improvement expected
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to useful Kiltealy Briggs but tailed off on sole bumper start; wind op since
runners_data.spotlight: From in-form yard and he's a half-brother to the useful Kiltealy Briggs; he's had wind surgery since his debut in a Carlisle bumper (2m1f, soft) last November but was tailed off at 16-1 and a transformation is needed.

runners_data.name: Prince Phil
runners_data.note: Moderate bumper form translated poorly to hurdles with two poor efforts over obstacles
runners_data.comment: Fairly encouraging fifth in sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off on both hurdle starts
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly encouraging fifth at Kelso in February in his sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off at triple-figure odds on both hurdle starts.

runners_data.name: Eagle's Cairn
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but lacks the class to trouble the leading contenders

runners_data.name: Run Baby Run
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who fades in finishes and faces a significant step up in class

races.paceDynamic: Newbrook Diamond is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset without pressure, creating a sustainable galloping pace over this testing 2m4f trip. With Gee Force Flyer likely to track in second, the lack of early pace means the tempo will be controlled rather than fierce. The bulk of the field are hold-up horses (Off The Jury, Heffalump, Prince Phil, Eagle's Cairn, Run Baby Run) who will need the pace to collapse in the final half-mile. This controlled tempo heavily favours the prominent runners who can stay in touch without expending energy, as the hold-up brigade may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front-Running
scenarios.trigger: If Newbrook Diamond maintains a steady gallop and the hold-up horses struggle to close
scenarios.body: Diamond gets first run and the prominent trackers like Gee Force Flyer benefit from the lack of early pressure, while class horse Off The Jury finds insufficient pace to unleash his trademark finish. The lack of genuine speed merchants allows the leaders to dictate ideal fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Off The Jury or Holy Joe find enough pace to close despite the steady tempo
scenarios.body: The class of Off The Jury or the unknown quantity of Holy Joe from the Elliott yard proves decisive as they find just enough gallop to reel in the leaders. Newbrook Diamond's effort flattens out in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers like Expensive Emotion or Heffalump shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: Wind surgery has transformed Heffalump or Expensive Emotion's previous winning form transfers effectively to hurdles. The lack of early pace suits their patient tactics and they benefit from fitness advantages over rivals returning from breaks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Newbrook Diamond goes too slowly and multiple hold-up horses finish strongly
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes pedestrian to the point where even the moderate finishers like Eagle's Cairn can close effectively. Multiple horses converge in a bunch finish where stamina and jumping become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Minutes To Spare is a non-runner, reducing the field to 9 and removing another potential pace angle
Watch Newbrook Diamond's early fractions as the sole leader - if he goes too steady, it compromises the hold-up horses' chances
Off The Jury needs to be positioned closer than usual given the lack of pace - James Bowen's tactics will be crucial
Holy Joe represents the only unknown quantity from a top yard - any market support would be significant
Heffalump's wind surgery and yard form suggests improvement expected after poor seasonal debut

races.name: Balnakeilly Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Barlovento
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with class edge but 39 days off and needs to overcome front-running bias

runners_data.name: King Roly
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent C&D record but 193-day absence is a significant concern
runners_data.comment: Has a very solid record here and could play a leading role if fully tuned up after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Made a good start to his chasing career last year, winning three times between May and September (2m3f/2m4f, good), with two of them over C&D; also effective on good to soft, unproven on softer; he has a very solid record here and could play a leading role if fully tuned up after a break.

runners_data.name: Great Pepper
runners_data.note: Consistent in defeat recently with 5lb claim advantage but trainer out of form

runners_data.name: Find A Fortune
runners_data.note: Proven on soft ground with strong pilot but disappointing recent efforts suggest regression

runners_data.name: Walking On A Dream
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner suited by trip and going but 5lb claimer lacks experience

runners_data.name: Karafon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing strong pace but poor recent form and weak trainer stats

runners_data.name: Wolfburg
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.comment: Won series final by 9l at Carlisle last month and is now 2-5 over fences; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Readily drew clear to win valuable series final by 9l at Carlisle (2m4f, good to soft) last month and is now 2-5 over fences; went up 11lb for that but could have untapped potential over this longer trip; respected.

runners_data.name: It's Hard To Know
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader with soft ground form but 137-day break undermines chances

races.paceDynamic: Walking On A Dream and It's Hard To Know will take this along at a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners unlikely to yield the lead easily. King Roly and Great Pepper will track the early pace in prominent positions, while the hold-up horses Barlovento and Karafon will settle towards the rear. The sustained pace over 2m4f on soft ground will create a searching test of stamina. This honest gallop strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close to the speed without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Walking On A Dream and It's Hard To Know engage in a prolonged speed duel through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will stretch the field and favour horses positioned prominently who can strike when the leaders tire. King Roly's class and course form makes him perfectly placed to pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Walking On A Dream gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The winner will have enough left to resist late challenges having controlled the pace throughout. Walking On A Dream's recent C&D win and proven front-running ability makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves unsustainable and the race falls apart in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade will pay dividends as they sweep past tired leaders. Barlovento's class and Harry Cobden's tactical nous on Find A Fortune become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the conditions or jumping pressure mounts
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner with solid course form or improving profile capitalizes on market leader disappointments. Great Pepper's recent placed efforts and Charlotte Jones' claim could spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Walking On A Dream could get too keen early under inexperienced Jack Power and compromise his stamina reserves
King Roly's lengthy absence may tell late despite his obvious class and course advantages
The pace battle between the two leaders could set up perfectly for late-running Barlovento
Great Pepper has been working into form but trainer James Moffatt's poor strike rate raises execution concerns
Find A Fortune's soft ground record suggests he could outrun current odds if pace develops favorably

races.name: British EBF Gold Castle 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: No Drama This End
runners_data.note: Class leader who should get uncontested lead with Blue Run withdrawn and has proven 3-mile stamina.

runners_data.name: Kazansky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed to track the leader and has strong form in similar company for in-form Elliott stable.

runners_data.name: Sogna In Grande
runners_data.note: Hold-up type on improving curve with two recent wins but faces significant step up in class here.

runners_data.name: Blue Run
runners_data.note: Non-runner so removes key pace element that would have pressured No Drama This End early.
runners_data.comment: Convincing win at Southwell in February and could have lots more to offer for top trainer
runners_data.spotlight: Left December's debut run (2m5f, good to soft) well behind to win in good style at Southwell (2m4f, soft) in February; faces a much higher calibre of opponent today but he could have lots more to offer for his top trainer.

runners_data.name: Tormund Giantsbane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good recent form but needs strong pace to be effective over this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Sept Etoiles
runners_data.note: Closer who has shown good form in similar grade but may find insufficient pace to close into with reduced early speed.

races.paceDynamic: No Drama This End and Blue Run are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead in this small field. However, with Blue Run withdrawn, No Drama This End faces less pace pressure and can dictate terms from the front with Kazansky sitting prominent behind. The honest gallop over 3 miles will test stamina reserves, but the reduced pace pressure means the race may not develop into a truly strong test. This race shape favours the front runner No Drama This End and prominent tracker Kazansky, as the hold-up horses may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If No Drama This End gets an uncontested lead with Blue Run withdrawn
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner can dictate fractions and has the class edge to repel challenges up the hill. His recent wins show he's effective when allowed to control races.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kazansky can track the pace and outkick No Drama This End
scenarios.body: James Bowen can sit second to the leader and has a strong finishing kick as shown in recent wins. The Elliott stable is in good form and this represents a slight drop in class.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong enough to set up closers
scenarios.body: The stamina test over 3 miles could find out the front runners late, allowing Tormund Giantsbane or Sept Etoiles to finish strongly. Both have shown good closing kicks in similar company.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Type Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Sogna In Grande's recent wins translate to this higher level
scenarios.body: The Kim Bailey runner has won his last two starts and could benefit from the strong pace. His light weight and improving profile make him a dangerous outsider.

watchPoints.text: No Drama This End getting an easy uncontested lead with Blue Run withdrawn could make him very hard to peg back
Kazansky's early positioning behind the leader as he has the tactical speed to exploit any lapses in concentration
The early fractions set by No Drama This End as slower tempo could play against the hold-up horses
Tormund Giantsbane and Sept Etoiles needing genuine pace up front to be effective from their hold-up styles
Sogna In Grande handling this significant class rise after winning his last two in lesser company

races.name: Fair Maid Of Perth Mares' Chase (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Apple Away
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 171-day break with consistent placed form in similar conditions, Derek Fox booking suggests confidence despite long absence.

runners_data.name: Panic Attack
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with superior RPR rating but faces quick 11-day turnaround and step up to 3m trip for first time this season.

runners_data.name: Shecouldbeanything
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with topspeed headgear applied, Gordon Elliott's 16-day spacing ideal but must overcome unsuitable pace scenario from rear.

runners_data.name: Ruby Island
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with pull headgear fitted, benefits from Nicky Richards' strong recent form but faces quality deficit against higher-rated rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Panic Attack will dominate the early pace from the front, with Apple Away likely tracking in second position through the early stages. With only four runners and Panic Attack's confirmed front-running style, this creates a moderate tempo that won't stress the leaders early on. The two hold-up horses, Shecouldbeanything and Ruby Island, will settle at the back and rely on their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick from close range, as the soft going will blunt the effectiveness of pure hold-up tactics over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Panic Attack Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Panic Attack maintains his recent winning form and handles the longer trip
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old controls the race from the front and his superior RPR of 160 proves decisive when Apple Away challenges. His recent 11-day turnaround and Dan Skelton's excellent strike rate support his chances of back-to-back wins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Apple Away Times Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Apple Away's prominent style proves ideal for tracking and outkicking Panic Attack
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old settles behind the leader and Derek Fox times his challenge perfectly in the soft conditions that suit her well. Her fresher legs after 171 days off could be crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves stronger than expected and sets up a closing finish
scenarios.body: Either Shecouldbeanything or Ruby Island benefits from a truly-run race that brings stamina into play over the full 3m trip. The soft going aids their finishing kick from the rear of the small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Panic Attack fails to handle the step up in trip or quick turnaround
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Ruby Island's fresher preparation tells despite her lower rating. Nicky Richards' excellent recent form with limited runners gives her an outside chance.

watchPoints.text: Panic Attack's jumping under pressure - if he makes any significant errors when challenged by Apple Away, his front-running advantage disappears
Apple Away's fitness levels after 171 days off - watch for any signs of rustiness in the early exchanges or lack of pace response when asked
Shecouldbeanything's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance despite hold-up style to have any chance in small field
Ruby Island's headgear effect - pull headgear suggests settling issues, watch if Danny McMenamin can get her to race kindly early
Early pace development - if Panic Attack goes too fast early or Apple Away presses him, it opens door for hold-up pair

races.name: Bedmax Capercaillie Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Fringill Dike
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 185-day break which raises serious fitness concerns despite the class advantage.

runners_data.name: Jigoro
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner in good form with Gordon Elliott's backing, though the 28lb rise in weight from last win is significant.

runners_data.name: Heltenham
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who excels on soft ground but needs others to go fast enough early to set up his finishing kick.

runners_data.name: Aeros Luck
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with strong recent soft ground form, well-weighted after claiming allowance and Sandy Thomson in good form.

runners_data.name: Coup De Coeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent soft ground record who benefits from quick recent return and strong finishing form.

runners_data.name: Sunnyvilla
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose 11-year-old legs may struggle over 2 miles despite excellent soft ground statistics.

runners_data.name: The Other Mozzie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with visor applied but concerning recent form suggests he may struggle to recapture best form.

races.paceDynamic: Jigoro will take the field along from the front with his proven leading tendencies, likely accompanied early by the prominent runners Fringill Dike, Aeros Luck, and Sunnyvilla pressing close behind. The pace should be reasonable rather than frantic given only one genuine front-runner, allowing the hold-up horses Heltenham, Coup De Coeur, and The Other Mozzie to track the leaders without being strung out. This controlled tempo over 2 miles on soft ground will create a tactical finish where positioning and timing matter more than pure speed. The race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close to Jigoro and strike when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jigoro sets a steady pace allowing prominent runners to travel comfortably in behind.
scenarios.body: The measured gallop will suit horses like Aeros Luck and Sunnyvilla who can sit handy and quicken when required. Hold-up horses will find themselves too far back when the race develops into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes strong with multiple prominent runners pressuring Jigoro.
scenarios.body: This will set up a perfect scenario for Heltenham and Coup De Coeur to close from the back as the early leaders weaken. The soft ground will aid their staying power in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Jigoro gets an uncontested lead and the chasers fail to mount a serious challenge.
scenarios.body: His recent winning form suggests he can sustain a gallop, and if the prominent runners don't apply enough pressure, he could kick clear approaching the last. The 17-day break keeps him fresh enough to see out the trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Jigoro goes too slow early and it becomes a crawling pace throughout.
scenarios.body: This would turn the race into a pure sprint from the last fence, where class and acceleration matter most. The higher-rated runners would have a significant advantage in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Fringill Dike's fitness after 185 days off - if he's not travelling smoothly by halfway, the layoff has taken its toll.
Jigoro's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could compromise his front-running tactics and hand initiative to prominent runners.
How quickly Heltenham and Coup De Coeur can get into contention turning for home - if they're still last with three to jump, their task becomes much harder.
The pace through the middle section - if it becomes pedestrian, it will suit the hold-up horses significantly more than current odds suggest.
Aeros Luck's position at the second last fence - if he's within striking distance, his consistent soft ground form makes him very dangerous.

races.name: Scone Palace Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Flying Fortune

runners_data.spotlight: Won four on the trot, all at around 2m4f, in 2024 (good/soft); was then absent for 484 days; needs to bounce back having suffered two heavy defeats this season.

runners_data.spotlight: Uttoxeter mares' novice winner last May (2m4f, good); placed in two similar races late last year but pulled up on handicap debut in a hot race at Newbury last month; this easier; worth considering.

runners_data.name: Tread Softly Now
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying bottom weight with veteran headgear but 46-day layoff and modest recent form

runners_data.name: Pitwood Road

runners_data.name: Atlantic City

races.paceDynamic: Atlantic City is the sole genuine pace-setter in this small field and will dictate terms from the front without pressure. The remaining six runners are all hold-up horses who will settle behind the early leader, creating a bunched field turning for home. This tactical setup strongly favours the front-runner Atlantic City, as she can control the tempo and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges. The lack of early pace pressure and abundance of hold-up horses creates an ideal scenario for the prominent runner to steal a march.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City gets an uncontested lead and maintains galloping room
scenarios.body: Atlantic City can dictate a steady tempo before quickening approaching the final flight, with the hold-up brigade left with too much ground to make up. The tactical advantage of controlling the race from the front proves decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario as Flying Fortune and Fresh As A Daisy time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. Atlantic City's early advantage is nullified by a frantic final furlong where class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City comes under pressure earlier than expected from tracking horses
scenarios.body: The race develops more competitively through the middle sections, suiting horses like Pitwood Road and Spit Spot who can adapt their hold-up style. The increased gallop exposes Atlantic City's stamina limitations over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get involved in a pace battle or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: Tread Softly Now or Just An Artist capitalise on a messy race where the market leaders compromise each other. The lighter weights and fresher profiles benefit from others' mistakes.

watchPoints.text: Atlantic City must be monitored closely at the third-last hurdle where her jumping under pressure will determine if she can maintain her tactical advantage
Flying Fortune's jumping rhythm early in the race will indicate whether the long absence has affected her fluency over obstacles
Fresh As A Daisy's position turning for home is crucial given her tendency to need strong driving when produced late
Just An Artist's movement on the soft ground compared to her course-winning performance will show if conditions suit
The pace through the first mile will determine whether this becomes a tactical crawl or a more genuinely-run contest

This controlled pace scenario strongly favours horses with finishing kicks who can produce late surges, giving the hold-up brigade a clear tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rioja Alta sets a steady tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where late runners can unleash telling kicks from off the pace. Hold-up horses with proven finishing ability get first run on tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the early pace-setters sustains their effort through the soft ground
scenarios.body: Either Rioja Alta or Jeteye capitalises on their forward position to control the race and kick clear before the closers can respond. Front-running tactics prove decisive on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the back of the course

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If Rioja Alta goes too slow and the race becomes a messy sprint

runners_data.name: Roi Du Roume
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 52-day break with poor recent form and inexperienced 7lb claimer
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner; not shown much hurdling, but interesting on h'cap debut after wind op
runners_data.spotlight: Won an Irish point in November (3m, yielding); creditable fourth in a Hereford bumper (2m, soft) on stable debut in January, but not as good in three runs over hurdles since; interesting up in trip on handicap debut on first run since wind surgery.

races.paceDynamic: Kells Priory will lead from the front with minimal pressure, as the few prominent runners (Maillot Blanc, Ebselysees, Palm Beach, Blue Indigo) are unlikely to challenge the pace early over this stamina-sapping 3m trip. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses (Shighness, Maura Jeanne, Monsieur Le Fuzz, Ck O'Mara, Am I Bovvered, Roi Du Roume) who will settle in behind the modest gallop. This uncontested early pace will create a tactical race that heavily favours horses with tactical speed and the ability to quicken, putting the hold-up horses at a significant advantage over those committed to making the running or tracking the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains uncontested and moderate as expected.
scenarios.body: The generous gallop allows patient hold-up types to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks, while front-runners and prominent racers pay for their early efforts. Horses like Shighness, Maura Jeanne, and Monsieur Le Fuzz can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can travel easily behind Kells Priory and kick clear.
scenarios.body: Maillot Blanc or Ebselysees benefit from the moderate pace without doing the donkey work, then have enough left to outstay the hold-up horses in the testing ground. Their race positioning proves crucial when the kick comes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Kells Priory sets an even more sedate pace than anticipated and the race becomes a sprint.
scenarios.body: The contest turns into a short-distance battle from the last hurdle where class and tactical speed matter most. Maura Jeanne and Ck O'Mara, both capable of sharp turns of foot, can capitalize on their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Kells Priory gets an easy lead and the soft ground blunts finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make ground in the testing conditions. Kells Priory's stamina and race fitness prove decisive despite carrying top weight.

watchPoints.text: Shighness could be overbet given her excellent soft ground record and trainer Micky Hammond's selective approach
Maura Jeanne's 3lb claimer S Connor may lack experience for tactical 3m race despite horse's class advantage
Kells Priory setting genuine pace early could change entire complexion if prominent horses track closer than expected
Blue Indigo's quick reappearance after just 9 days may indicate connections are not confident about condition
Monsieur Le Fuzz could outrun odds if Rebecca Menzies' current good form continues with this well-handicapped runner
